result.stdout:
PbLite.ProtoGen - proto3 to C# class generator

Usage: pblite-gen <input> [options]

Arguments:
  <input>                .proto file or directory containing .proto files

Options:
  -o, --output <DIR>     Output directory (default: current directory)
  -n, --namespace <NS>   Override C# namespace
  --multiple-files       Generate one .cs file per message/enum
  -h, --help             Show help
